description: ADD ONE LINE, OR SEVERAL, to the end of the draft — the same block shapes qa_report_build takes, so nothing has to be translated on the way out. The usual rhythm is one at a time, as things are noticed: a `finding` the moment it reproduces, a `shot` naming a picture from qa_shot_list, a `note` for the thing that is not a defect but matters. A picture is held BY NAME, never by pixels — so re-cropping or re-marking it later changes the report too. It answers with how many lines ACTUALLY went in: at the cap the draft keeps what fits, and saying «added 8» while 3 landed is how a document loses its middle.
